scheme_name: West Bengal Handloom and Khadi Weavers Financial Benefit Scheme 2024: Support for One Time Settlement (OTS) of NPA Accounts of PWCS
other_conditions: Applicant must be a Primary Weavers’ Cooperative Society (PWCS), a Khadi society, or an individual weaver
The PWCS must be viable as of 31/03/2024
Application must be submitted in the prescribed format before the Director, Textiles
Application can be made online or offline
benefits_summary: Provides 100% of the overdue principal plus 25% of the overdue interest for NPA accounts of viable PWCS, with the remaining interest written off by the bank.
